title: Maleficent influence of the presabbath
html_source: Presabbath is friday, the day before the Jewish Sabbath, is considered an unlucky day because it is traditionally supposed to be the day on which Adam and Eve fell and were expelled from the Garden of Eden. In Christian tradition this is compounded by the fact that Jesus was crucified on Friday (Gifford & Seidman p 566). Interestingly, Muslims consider it their holiest day of the week – their equivalent of Jewish Saturday or Christian Sunday.
